scope: Two vendored profiler files read whole and pin verified; syntax parsed only. No program execution, signals, Django server or profile output generation.

findings.detail: Profiler CLI catches all SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt then continues report generation without preserving exit status. A profiled command failure can appear as profiler process success.
Unexpected profiled exception propagates before profiler.stop; no enclosing finally restores instrumentation in that path. CLI mutates sys.argv/sys.path and closes stdout when used as report stream.

Files import top-level pyinstrument rather than explicit vendored-relative package. Depending on environment this can resolve an external installation or fail; vendored presence is not runtime provenance.

Django middleware profiles when query argument is present or profile directory configured. No independent permission check in this file; applicability depends on hosting app and Django settings, not duplicate library behavior.
Signal fallback changes instrumentation mechanism. Comparisons need profiler mode/backend recorded; passing syntax does not establish accurate or comparable timings.

relation_to_goal: Tracked vendored tooling review only; no duplicate algorithm selected or production code copied.
